description:
List the questions this platform has published, each with its frozen spec.

    An event's spec -- asset, operator, baseline day, target day, tolerance --
    is fixed before anyone participates, which is exactly why its wording and
    its settling rule cannot drift apart. Set `joinable_only` to true to see
    only the events still accepting a number.

    Returns the platform's own JSON, including `event_id`, `question`,
    `resolve_by`, `join_closes_at`, `participants` and `join_open`.
name: list_events
